name: Four Seasons Hotel Amman
insider_take: A luxurious oasis perched on Amman's highest hill, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the ancient city where Roman ruins meet modern Jordan.
whats_special: Located on prestigious Jabal Amman, this Four Seasons sits at 1,000 meters above sea level, making it one of the highest luxury hotels in the Middle East. The property features Jordan's only rooftop infinity pool with 360-degree city views, and its spa incorporates ancient Nabataean wellness rituals using Dead Sea minerals sourced just 45 minutes away.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop restaurant - you'll witness the call to prayer echoing across the seven hills of Amman while enjoying unobstructed views of the illuminated Roman Amphitheater below.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive "Royal Heritage Tour" includes private access to the nearby Amman Citadel at dawn, plus the property's renowned afternoon tea service featuring traditional Jordanian ma'amoul cookies and views of the ancient Roman Theater that's literally carved into the hillside across the valley.
pros: Prime location in the upscale Fifth Circle neighborhood with panoramic views of Amman
Exceptional dining options including award-winning restaurants and a celebrated rooftop bar
World-class spa and wellness facilities offering rejuvenating treatments and an impressive fitness center
Impeccably appointed rooms and suites featuring elegant décor and state-of-the-art amenities
Flawless Four Seasons signature service with personalized attention and concierge expertise for exploring Jordan
cons: Luxury pricing places it at the top tier of Amman's hotel market
Distance from some of Amman's historic downtown attractions may require transport
